violations.why: The ISR can preempt between the task's assignment and its use, repointing v_timber at the ISR's stack local. The task then dereferences the wrong pointer.
The ISR can overwrite v_timber after line 28 and before line 31 reads it, so the task uses the ISR's pointer.
The ISR can change v_timber between the task's two reads, so line 31 dereferences a different pointer than line 30 did.
v_tundra and v_indigo both point at v_vessel. The ISR's read through v_tundra can run between the task's two writes and see the intermediate value 2.
